subject: Ask: Small sandbox bridge credit while SDK team resolves connector bug
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam@integrative.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: POC stall - SDK connector failing; asking for small sandbox buffer

Hi Vanessa,

Quick update from our side: the IntegrativeAI engineering team hit a blocker with the SDK -> data connector layer when trying to provision the final adapter to our internal staging. We reproduced a repeatable failure that causes intermittent tokenization mismatch and requires a small patch from our engineers plus a follow-up CI run. ETA from our eng lead is ~5 business days.

We're mid-POC and the team is approaching the end of the sandbox credits you provided. Could Redwood extend a small "sandbox bridge" — roughly 50k tokens — so we can finish the last test matrix and complete the evaluation? We can fast-track the SOW sign once we validate the connector.

I've attached the integration_error_log.txt and a short note from our platform lead. Appreciate any short-term runway you can provide.

Best,
Sam
Sam Park
Head of Platform, IntegrativeAI
attachments: integration_error_log.txt

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam@integrative.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC stall - SDK connector failing; asking for small sandbox buffer

Hi Sam — thanks for the details and for attaching the logs. Sorry to hear about the blocker. I looped in Marissa (CS lead) and Ben (sales ops) to confirm whether we can allocate a short buffer while your engineering team finishes the patch.

Quick ask for your side so we can process internally: can you confirm the token estimate (50k), which environment it needs applied to (staging vs sandbox account), and whether you want a simple one-time credit or a short trial extension window. If you reply here I'll move it through approvals this morning.

— Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC stall - SDK connector failing; asking for small sandbox buffer

Vanessa — 50k one-time credit to staging is fine for a customer at this stage, especially given the clear SOW pipeline and short ETA. Approve.

Ben — please book as a sandbox bridge under RD-84712, mark source as "engineering integration relief," and note that accounting should not auto-revoke demonstration credits if they dip below threshold during repair window.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam@integrative.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, procurement@integrative.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC stall - SDK connector failing; asking for small sandbox buffer

Hi Sam — quick follow to confirm we've provisioned a one-time 50,000-token sandbox bridge to your IntegrativeAI staging project (project id: intg-staging-7). The credit will be visible in the console within 10 minutes and is tagged to deal RD-84712.

Notes / process:
- Credit type: one-time sandbox buffer (non-recurring)
- Amount: 50k tokens
- Applies to: staging (intg-staging-7) only
- Expiry: 14 days from provisioning (2027-03-25 23:59:59 UTC)
- Approval: Marissa Cole (CS)

Ben has added the internal record and SOW-draft-v2.pdf is attached for your signatures if you'd like to accelerate procurement once tests pass. Please reply when your eng lead confirms the patch is merged; we'll prioritize a transition to Dedicated if you decide to proceed.

Good luck with the fix — ping me if anything else is needed.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
attachments: SOW-draft-v2.pdf
